sentences.text: Sharif @ Riyazul vs State Of Uttarakhand on 11 December, 2024

Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
 First Bail Application No.544 of 2024
Sharif @ Riyazul ........Applicant
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand ........Respondent

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. Pankaj Kumar Sharma, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. Vipul Painuly, Brief Holder for the State.

Applicant is in judicial custody in Case Crime No.632 of 2023, under Sections 452, 323, 376(2)(n),
376(3) Ipc and 3(a)/4(2), 5(k)/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012,
Police Station Kotwali Manglaur, District Haridwar.
He has sought his release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.

Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the victim is deaf and mute; she was produced for examination in the court, but the court has observed that the victim, due to her inability to communicate, is not able to tell about the incident.
4. It is also argued that according to the prosecution, the younger sister of the victim is an eye- witness and she has not supported the prosecution case in the trial; she has been declared hostile.
4. This fact has not been denied by the learned State Counsel.
5. Having considered, this Court is of the view that it is a case fit for bail and the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.

6. The bail application is allowed.
7. Let the applicant be released on bail, on his executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the court concerned.
(Ravindra Maithani, J) 11.12.2024 Ravi Sharif @ Riyazul vs State Of Uttarakhand on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32363306/
